results.fact: Season this route is actually climbed in

ops.expect: Late July through September gives the driest brush and firmest footing on the upper slopes. Go earlier and you'll likely fight wet slide alder and residual snow patches on shaded ground; wait until October and the first crest snow can return. A separate winter/spring snow-climb or ski-touring line up the same general terrain exists (popular with Stevens Pass backcountry skiers), but it's a steeper, avalanche-exposed undertaking distinct from this summer scramble.
ops.value: December through April, on consolidated snow as a snowshoe or ski ascent. Without snow cover there is no trail above Skyline Ridge and the slopes are brushy.
